DISCOVERY 301, THE COURT MODIFIED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AND RULED AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT CATHOLIC HEALTHCARE WEST, DBA MERCY MEDICAL CENTER'S MOTION FOR AN ORDER COMPELLING PLAINTIFF TO ATTEND MENTAL EXAMINATION IS GRANTED ON CONDITION THAT: (A) THE EXAM OCCURS WITHIN 75 MILES OF PLACE OF PLAINTIFF'S RESIDENCE; (B) ONLY PLAINTIFF AND THE DOCTOR ARE PRESENT DURING THE EXAMINATION; (C) PLAINTIFF MAY MAKE AN AUDIOTAPE OF THE EXAMINATION AND A COPY OF THE AUDIOTAPE TO BE PROVIDED TO THE OTHER PARTY; (D) THE DOCTOR MAY ASK WHATEVER QUESTIONS THE DOCTOR DEEMS NECESSARY TO PERFORM THE EVALUATION; (E) PLAINTIFF SHALL BE GIVEN THOSE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED BY CCP 2032.610 AND 2032.640; (F) THE EXAMINATION SHALL NOT EXCEED 6 HOURS AND SHALL BE RESCHEDULED IF IT IS DELAYED OR THERE IS A BREAK EXCEEDING ONE HOUR; AND (G) DEFENDANT IS ENTITLED TO A CANCELLATION FEE IN THE AMOUNT OF $2400 IF PLAINTIFF CANCELS WITHIN 2 BUSINESS DAYS OF THE EXAM. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE : PETER J. BUSCH, NOT REPORTED.
